tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhal chems mthar thug gcig ma bzhugs so/ /

āoṃ āḥhūṃ/ rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis/ skal ldan rnams la gdams pa/ e ma ho/ /mthar thug cig tu dril na 'di ltar yin/ /sus kyang ma byas gdod nas rang byung ba'i/ /sems nyid rgyal po rang bzhin rdzogs pa cha ེ / /rin chen gter 'di rtag tu lta bar gyis/ /mi g.yo gsum ldan rlung rig mkha' la gtad/ /rang las byung ba'i 'od kyi khang bzang na/ /rang rig rgyal po rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /gsal stong 'dzin med nam mkha'i dkyil du 'char/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang la zhog /dag snang dngos 'di rnam kun stong pa'i gzugs/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu chu y-i zla ba 'dra/ /sna tshogs sems 'di 'byung ba rlung dang mtshungs/ /gang shar dran 'dzin ma byed gang dgar thongs/ /sgom du med de rnam kun stong pa'i gzugs/ /gang shar rgyal po lhun rdzogs ngang la rol/ /rang rig rang grol grol ba gzhan nas min/ /bcos bslad ma byed rang bzhin lhug par zhog /mi 'gyur mnyam pa'i ngang la gnas pa yin/ /'di ltar nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gang la zhen na de yang nges par thongs/ /dmigs gtad zhen pa byung na rnal 'byor min/ /gang shar zhen pa med na ci dgar rol/ /nang gi rang gdangs phyi ru shar ba'i tshe/ /shes nyams snang nyams 'phel 'gribs ci byung yang*/ /dgag sgrub ma byed rig pa'i cho 'phrul yin/ /gtad med rgyal po 'dzin med ngang du gyur/ /bzang ngan blang dor thams cad spros pa'i ngang*/ /gnyis snang mtshan ma thams cad 'khrul pa'i gzugs/ /rtsol sgrub zhen pa thams cad sgrib phyed nyid/ /re dogs 'ching pa thams cad zhen pa'i rgyu/ /gdod ma'i ngang 'di brjod 'das gzhi rtsa bras/ /spang blang rtsol sgrub re dogs phyogs ris med/ /gnas der gnas na kun kyang chos kyi sku/ / cog bzhag rang grol 'bad med gang gis yul/ /gnas lugs mthong na gzhi rtsa gang yang med/ / chig chod mthong la sgom pa rdul tsam med/ /snyems dang bral la spyod pa yod ma yin/

khregs chod mthong la dran 'dzin gnyen po med/ /thod rgal mthong la sems 'dzin sgom pa med/ /rnam rtog byung na gang shar rang grol yin/ rtsol skyab ma byed rang babs lhug par zhog /so ma gnyug ma ma bcos zang thal dang*/ /cir snang thams cad chos sku'i zhing du 'char/ /'di nyid bla ma'i gdams ngag kun dril nas/ /phyi rabs rnal 'byor rnams kyi don du bkod/ /'di ltar nyams su longs shig rigs kyi bu/ /sangs rgyas sa la tshegs med bde blag 'gro /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang*/ / gzhan don lhun grub chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /gru chen ngogs la mgron po chas pa bzhin/ /dri med 'od zer thar pa'i gling du 'gro /sdod pa'i yun med brtson pas sgrubs shig bu/ /dge zhing bkra shis pa gyur cig /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8) mes po'i shul bzhag las/ mkha' 'gro snying thig - PAGE 206 --PAGE 207--PAGE 205-
